lines.vo: How much of your day are you actually choosing?
Less than you think. A lot of it is autopilot.
Jay maps out his morning routine in his Daily Habit Builder.
In one diary study, people wrote down what they were doing and thinking every hour.
About forty three percent of their actions were habits, done while thinking about something else.
lines.cap: About 43% of their actions were habits, done while thinking about something else.

lines.vo: Habits run on cues, like the same place and the same time, so your brain can coast.
So you don't need more willpower. You need better autopilot.
Same cue, check the box, every day. That's how you stay on track.

hook: Almost *half* your day runs on autopilot
